whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hi Q Foods,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 3.9★ reviews with over 1,100 happy customers in Gardanibagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for direct local delivery and takeout inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, signature dishes showcase, aur location/directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hiq

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Hi Q Foods, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Hi Q Foods) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a showcase of your top-rated dishes in Gardanibagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
